welcome.title: Typing practice with your own words.
welcome.text: Start practicing with an official pack, or create a list of the words you want to learn.
welcome.lists: {count, plural, one {# word list} other {# word lists}}
welcome.practices: {count, plural, one {# practice completed} other {# practices completed}}

storage: You can use every practice and editing feature without signing in. Word lists, practice history, and devices are saved in this browser. Signing in with GitHub switches to a separate storage location, your account, which syncs across devices. Data in the browser is not moved automatically.
storageAccount: You are signed in, so your word lists, practice history, and devices are saved to your account and synced with other devices and browsers signed in with the same GitHub account. They are kept separately from data saved in this browser without signing in.
